title: Canonical descent of one finitely presented module map over a directed preorder
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F:I\to\mathrm{CRing} a functor, i_0\in I, and A=\operatorname{colim}F [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let M,N be finitely presented F(i_0)-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], and let f:A\otimes_{F(i_0)}M\to A\otimes_{F(i_0)}N be A-linear. Scalar extension means tensor product, with comparison isomorphisms induced by the extension-restriction adjunction [def-pod-ring-scalar-extension]. For i\ge i_0 let e_i(X):A\otimes_{F(i_0)}X\to A\otimes_{F(i)}(F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}X) be the canonical comparison, incorporating the colimit cocone equality and scalar-extension associativity. Then there is i\ge i_0 and an F(i)-linear g:F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}M\to F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}N satisfying e_i(N)^{-1}\circ(A\otimes_{F(i)}g)\circ e_i(M)=f. No complex, graded family, boundedness hypothesis, or differential compatibility is involved.

source.place: Tag 05N7 (2), the map clause; its finite presentation matrix argument, used in Perfect Tag 09RE affine case (1)

proof.text: Work on the directed upper tail J = Ici i0. For each j equip F(j) with its F(i0)-algebra structure and define D(j) = F(j) tensor N. The ring transitions and coprojections induce F(i0)-linear maps d and mu on these tensors. Check composition of d and compatibility with mu by tensor induction and functoriality. Uncurry f to the F(i0)-linear map h(m) = f(1 tensor m).

Apply lem-weil-pbc-directed-colimit-base-change-elementwise to N. Every element in the final tensor module lifts to a D(j), and every stage tensor with zero final image becomes zero later. Finset induction and directed upper bounds make these two assertions simultaneous for any finite family. No presentation or finiteness hypothesis on N is used.

Unpack Module.FinitePresentation for M as a finite generator set sigma with a finite set tau generating the kernel of pi : (sigma ->0 F(i0)) -> M. Lift h(sigma) at one stage to obtain a0 on the finite free module. Each a0(t), t in tau, has zero final image because mu composed with a0 equals h composed with pi. Move to one stage killing this finite family. The transported free-module map kills the entire kernel, so Submodule.liftQ and LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective construct an F(i0)-linear a : M -> D(j) with mu composed with a = h. This is the private helper fp_lift, proved in full. Empty generator or relation sets are included in the Finset inductions.

Curry a by LinearMap.liftBaseChange to obtain the required F(j)-linear g. ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp_hom_app_one_tmul, after substituting the cocone equality, gives the unit-tensor equation for the exact comparison e in the statement. Tensor induction proves e(N).hom(mu(y)) = 1 tensor y for every y in D(j). Cancel e(N).hom, and use ExtendScalars.hom_ext, ExtendScalars.map_tmul and liftBaseChange_one_tmul to check the commuting square on 1 tensor m. This yields the specified conjugation equality, with no change to its signature.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05N7 (2), via Tag 05LI (3): finite source generators and kernel generators; tensor-colimit elementwise criterion and canonical comparison on unit tensors. Read the official Stacks pages https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05N7 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05LI because the local literature file is absent.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePresentation_map_directedColimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (i₀ : I) (M N : ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i₀))
    (hM : Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i₀) M)
    (hN : Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i₀) N)
    (f : (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i₀).hom).obj M ⟶
      (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i₀).hom).obj N) :
    let e (i : Set.Ici i₀) (X : ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i₀)) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun r ↦ (extendScalars r).obj X)
        (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.w F (homOfLE i.property)).symm)) ≪≫
      (extendScalarsComp (F.map (homOfLE i.property)).hom (colimit.ι F i.val).hom).app X
    ∃ i : Set.Ici i₀,
      ∃ g : (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE i.property)).hom).obj M ⟶
        (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE i.property)).hom).obj N,
        (e i M).hom ≫ (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i.val).hom).map g ≫ (e i N).inv = f
